# Platinum metallic powder (from ore, and from the line's own refined salt) dissolves in aqua
# regia; the concentrate with ammonium chloride gives platinum salt (sifted, then smelted back
# to metallic powder) and reprecipitated platinum, which calcium reduces to platinum dust; the
# calcium chloride is electrolysed back to calcium. Keys checked against the dev runtime's
# server harness DB (run 20261111T104223Z); the palladium, rhodium, ruthenium, osmium and
# iridium branches of the line start from its byproducts and are left to the heuristic.
